d.title: Shinmai Maou no Testament: Toujou Basara no Hard Sweet na Nichijou
d.en: The Testament of Sister New Devil OVA
d.jp: 新妹魔王の契約者 東城刃更のハードスウィートな日常
syn: The Testament of Sister New Devil OVA
d.synopsis:
OVA episode of Shinmai Maou no Testament, sold with the eight volume of the light novel of the same property.

Part A: Maria is up to her ususal hijinx using a new prototype succubus video camera she tries to record one of Mio's erotic dreams.

Part B: Basara is invited by Hasegawa Sensei to her apartment for dinner. He gets more hospitality than he ever would have expected!
